verdict.rationale: Opting out of vendor usage tracking is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack's 'telemetry' mentions refer to the customer's own ingested observability data (logs, metrics, traces). None of them describe disabling Elastic's product usage telemetry or tracking, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
